provenance.kind: AI-generated promotional illustration; not an actual-model screenshot
provenance.reviewNotes: Corrected body-colored feet and plain round disk; two islands retained; darker body and minor terrain contours.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Runtime slopes and shorelines are more schematic and faceted, with flatter turquoise water.
Diagonal body streaking resembles brushed material rather than rough volcanic rock; neither is established damage.
holds_preserved: Existing unresolved rear lid/hinge attachment appearance hold.
visual_review.ledger_reconciliation: Ledger reports rotated runtime follow-up did not demonstrate broken geometry; that is historical evidence, not a fresh inspection here, and does not clear hidden contact or the decision hold.

observations.desktop_closed: Large crater-like island and smaller pointed green island on turquoise water with cream shores; charcoal streaked body, brass fittings and dark block feet.
observations.desktop_open: Empty gray-green cavity and turquoise rim remain readable. Dark gap below the raised slate lid makes the hinge/body connection visually ambiguous.
observations.marketing: Same two-island composition, cream shorelines, aqua water, slate body, gold clasp/plain disc/corner caps and chunky body-colored feet.
observations.mobile_closed: Both peaks, body and feet remain visible; long title wraps cleanly and does not collide with the viewer.
observations.mobile_open: Complete open chest with no UI overlap; rear-right rim looks stepped and small hinge joins cannot be resolved.

visual_review.reason: Identity and framing survive, but the independent open-view concern supports retaining the existing review hold.
unresolved_visual_questions: Conspicuous desktop rear lid/hinge separation needs rear/side contact evidence or explicit acceptance; not a proven detached lid.
